headline: Executive order relating to the Council of Europe's Group of States Against Corruption (GRECO), an anti-corruption monitoring body.
what_it_does: Based on the title, this order concerns the Council of Europe's Group of States Against Corruption, a group of countries that review each other's anti-corruption efforts. Orders like this usually name an international group as a 'public international organization' under US law. That label gives the group and its officials certain legal protections and exemptions in the United States. The title alone does not confirm the exact details.

who_it_affects.group: The Council of Europe's Group of States Against Corruption and its officials
who_it_affects.how: The order likely gives the group and its staff certain legal protections and exemptions when operating in the United States.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely upon signing on December 18, 2001, though the source does not state this.
